components.name: FD001 sensor validation and local replay

components.scope: FD001 replay; live broker not exercised

components.interface: validated SensorMessage to fd001_sensor_reading point and query adapter

components.name: FD001 LSTM inference

components.blocker: best_model.pt is absent; protected checkpoint must not be regenerated

components.name: NLP preprocessing, NER, severity
components.interface: maintenance-log dict -> original/normalized text, entities, heuristic severity
components.scope: synthetic/interface fixtures; not Azure technician narratives

components.name: NLP embeddings
components.blocker: requires transformers model/tokenizer availability and pinned external artifacts

components.name: Fusion validation and alignment
components.interface: canonical (unit_id, cycle), 64-D sensor + 768-D text, explicit namespace/provenance
components.scope: synthetic fixture/interface validation; genuine fusion blocked by approvals and availability

components.name: Multimodal training contract compatibility

components.scope: no training entry point; main explicitly blocks unapproved training

components.name: Azure PdM temporal dataset and model
